summary.text: Protect your log-in details, check who contacted you, and inspect links before opening them.

steps.name: Protect your log-in details
steps.text: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details. CPF officers will never ask for them.

items: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details.
CPF officers will NEVER ask for your Singpass or bank log-in details.

steps.name: Check who contacted you
steps.text: Check that the message came through an official CPF channel. Check that email addresses are spelt correctly.

points.lead: CPF Board uses these official channels:
items: Emails ending with @cpf.gov.sg or @e.cpf.gov.sg. Check the spelling.
WhatsApp sender "CPF Board Text Us" with the blue badge, phone number 6031 5753.

steps.name: Check links before opening
steps.text: Check the full address of a link before you open it. It should end with “.gov.sg”.

items: Check that the link’s domain ends with “.gov.sg”.
On a computer, hover over the link to view its full address.
On a mobile device, hold your finger down on the link to see its full address.

steps.name: Report suspicious messages
steps.text: Report messages pretending to be from CPF Board through its official hotline or Write to us. If you are unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call 1799.

items: Report messages spoofing CPF Board via its official hotline or Write to us.
If unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline via 1799.

sources.page_title: How do I avoid falling prey to phishing scams?

quotes.text: Here are some tips on how to protect yourself against phishing scams pretending to come from CPF Board:
Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details with anyone. CPF officers will NEVER ask for your Singpass or bank log-in details.
Check the source of the message. CPF Board will only contact you through these official channels:

Stay vigilant and examine the links embedded in the message. Messages from CPF Board may contain links to Government websites. Before clicking on such links, please check that the domain of the link ends with “.gov.sg” by hovering your mouse over the link to view the full address.
Report any suspicious messages spoofing CPF Board via our CPF official hotline or Write to us. If unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline via 1799.
